The account states that thresholds are now capability-specific; the narrowing of the misuse trigger to CBRN is identifiable only with v1.0 in hand.
Highly protected against most attackers restates the v1.0 standard at similar force; the actor-scope narrowing is the material change.
Access management around sensitive assets governs the same object in generalised form; the less-prescriptive direction is stated.

Should-level measures become will-level controls while specificity and insider scope narrow; both directions present.

The affirmative-case requirement is announced; the threshold-domain change is coded on the threshold rows.

The watch-list commitment has no counterpart; a risk category in the FCF is not a watch-list.
